# Let's fetch the content of all habit tracking notes to check the posture habit.
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzaW1wbGVfbm90ZStzdG1jY29AZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.8r41lkimvY80Xpnx2F0kQI45ddAGCfxxJTITk4dk9yk'
note_ids = list(range(11, 35))  # 11 to 34 inclusive
posture_data = []
for nid in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=nid)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = note['title']
    date_str = title.split('for ')[1]
    content = note['content']
    # Find the line for practiced_good_posture
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            posture_data.append((date_str, value))
            break

# Compute the longest streak of "yes" for practiced_good_posture
from datetime import datetime

# posture_data is list of (date_str, value) in reverse chronological order
# Sort by date ascending
posture_data_sorted = sorted(posture_data, key=lambda x: datetime.strptime(x[0], '%Y-%m-%d'))

max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
for date_str, value in posture_data_sorted:
    if value == 'yes':
        current_streak += 1
        if current_streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = current_streak
    else:
        current_streak = 0

print(max_streak)
